title: SKILL.md frontmatter field types
description: Spec types of the SKILL.md frontmatter: name, description, license, compatibility and allowed-tools are non-empty strings, metadata maps string keys to string values, name, description and compatibility are not scalars that PyYAML would type, plus the Claude Code host fields argument-hint and disable-model-invocation. The instance is the parsed frontmatter; x-yaml-string reads the typed-key set of the strict YAML reader. A $defs entry with a description is a message rule. Fix: give each field the spec type (allowed-tools is one space-separated string, metadata is 'key: string' pairs) and quote a name, description or compatibility that looks like a number, a date or yes/no.
$comment: source: agentskills.io specification field types and skill-creator quick_validate (PyYAML), as cited in the eva.py comments at PYYAML_STR_FIELDS and HOST_SKILL_FIELDS (URLs not re-verified in A2); house: argument-hint and disable-model-invocation typing; severity: fail (field-types row, must); protects: claude, codex, opencode, hermes.
